title: First Stars, Mostly From the Telescope

content.question: Are the first stars over the island the same ones I saw from the perch last night, or do they move when nobody is watching?
content.method: At dusk I sat by the telescope and kept my eyes on it, which is the only way to watch anything properly. I looked through it twice, once at the brightest point over the water and once at a smaller one above the big rock. I did not touch the telescope with my paws, since it is not mine to rearrange, though I did sit very close to it.
content.result: The bright point stayed where it was. The small one moved a little while I was looking, or maybe I moved. I have written down both possibilities. I think the telescope is working well enough for a beginner like me to be impressed by it.
